profile.headline: Lead Engineer at The Walt Disney Company
profile.summary: Application Developer, Sr. Consultant, Technical Lead in a wide variety of ecomm/retail/supply chain business applications.  Focused on client/server with multiple backend integrations.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer for the enterprise API services platform supporting multiple E-Commerce businesses, such as digital commerce for Disney Store North America & Europe and Theme Parks.
Responsible for design artifacts, development, testing, and delivery of APIs.
Ensures successful backend integration of Ecommerce REST services in the areas of address validation, content, commerce transactions, fraud detection, and tax.
Serves as solution engineer to various internal partners
Provides executive presentations.

positions.title: Manager Software Engineering
positions.description:
Managed a team of 7 developers and testers for TicketMaster's Commerce Shopping flow through full stack implementation.
Responsible for daily scrum standups, retros, and sprint planning.
Key contact for cross departmental clients.
Ensured success of monthly box office demos.

positions.title: Sr. Sales Consultant
positions.description:
•	Delivered quality standard Oracle ATG Web Commerce presentations and POCs
•	Presented Oracle product strengths, features, benefits, and industry competitive advantages
•	Design, validate, and present Oracle software solutions to include advanced product concepts, future direction, and 3rd party complimentary commerce products.
•	Technical tasks included front-end skinning (page construction, image manipulation, and publishing web pages) of applications using JavaScript, HTML, and JSP
•	Built ATG prototypes that ran on JBOSS based on J2EE (Servlets/JSP) Framework in Windows XP, UNIX, Redhat Linux, Solaris, WebSphere, and WebLogic environment

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Lead developer in providing complex technical solutions for Disney Consumer Products global online forecasting application.
Level three support for ongoing production sales and budget forecast cycle.
Technical designer for new business enhancements for global online forecasting application.
Technologies include: java (other web technologies), sybase, business objects crystal reports.

positions.title: Sr. ATG Consultant
positions.description: Sr Application Developer for ATG Dynamo Web application project for Buena Vista Television.  Responsibilities include technical requirement analysis,  implementation, and defect management.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description: Staffed on various high profile projects such as ATT Wireless (Redmond), American Airlines (Dallas), and Disney (Los Angeles). Focused on ATG Dynamo Web application development with multiple backend system integrations.
